stats.label: To beat the world No. 3 in straight games
Scoreline in the straight-games win over the top seed
India's Anahat Singh, into the quarter-finals

diaspora_bullets: First Indian to win a women's singles silver in squash at the Asian Games
Won in Redwood City as squash heads for its Olympic debut at Los Angeles 2028
news_summary: India's Anahat Singh, 18, beat eight-time world champion and top seed Nour El Sherbini 11-8, 11-8, 11-7 in 30 minutes at the Silicon Valley Open in Redwood City to reach the quarter-finals.
payoff: The biggest win of her professional career — over a champion she had never faced before.
